content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overestimate prices, showing upward bias despite negative supply net events.", "Sentiment shifts from bullish to bearish during high supply events, causing forecast divergence from true outcomes.", "Forecast lags behind true price movements, especially after consecutive auction supply events.", "Mean-reversion patterns emerge when sentiment aligns with falling prices, suggesting model underestimation of volatility.", "High bullish sentiment correlates with forecast overshoots, indicating sentiment-driven overconfidence in price increases.", "Model accuracy improves when bullish sentiment is low and supply net is negative, suggesting sentiment-supply interaction matters.", "Forecast bias is amplified during consecutive auction supply events, indicating model sensitivity to supply timing.", "True price movements often outpace model forecasts during bearish sentiment periods, suggesting model underestimates downside risk."]}
